Definition: Joach, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Joah = "Jehovah is brother"; 1) son of Asaph and chronicler to Hezekiah; 2) a Gershonite son or grandson of Zimmah; 3) a Korhite, 3rd son of Obed-edom and doorkeeper in the time of David; 4) son of Joahaz and chronicler to king Josiah
